name: Nimble
description: Nimble connects AI agents to the live web with vertically-tuned search, extraction, mapping, and crawling. Each query is routed to the right sources and returned as structured JSON instead of noisy text. Headless browsers fully render JavaScript-heavy and anti-bot-protected sites that indexed search tools can't reach. Focus modes (shopping, social, news, geo, general) tune sourcing and extraction per domain, so agents get task-ready data without extra LLM parsing calls. SOC 2 compliant and built for production scale.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Nimble to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Nimble to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.nimbleway.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Nimble MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nimble lists 18 MCP tools, including nimble_search, nimble_extract, nimble_extract_async, nimble_map, nimble_crawl_run, nimble_crawl_status, nimble_crawl_list, nimble_crawl_terminate, nimble_task_results, nimble_agents_list, nimble_agents_get, and nimble_agents_run.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Nimble?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Nimble in data on the Manufact MCP catalog include Aura, Clarivate IPOne CompuMark Trademarks, Enterpret, Motion Creative Analytics, and Origin.
Nimble requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Nimble is developed by Nimble. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
